title: Where Does This Food Come From?
retry: Listen once more and choose a pile.

items.note: An apple grows on a tree.
A carrot is the root of a plant.
A potato grows underground on a plant.
Corn grows on a tall plant.
A tomato grows on a plant.
Beans grow inside pods on plants.
Chicken meat comes from a chicken.
Fish is meat from an animal that lives in water.

items.text: A piece of cheese made from cow’s milk.
items.note: People make this cheese from cow’s milk.

items.text: A spoonful of yogurt made from cow’s milk.
items.note: This yogurt starts as cow’s milk.
People grind peanuts from a plant to make peanut butter.

items.text: A bowl of oatmeal cooked in water.
items.note: Oats are seeds from an oat plant.
Bees make honey from flower nectar.
